study.question: Observed trajectories: baseline-din AUC0.6555440824 is the utility reference; original joint g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached AUC0.6667535475. Round24 embedding12/scorer-half/joint reductions reached 0.6641111849/0.6654368616/0.6657555717. Round25 tower-half/residual-half/both reached 0.6654569217/0.6665364798/0.6652781389, illustrating uneven marginal capacity utility. Round26 indexed routing preserved same-width AUC exactly while removing unused adapter calls; width12 reached0.6669370377. Round27 active coefficients preserved width12 AUC0.6669370377 with p50/p95 21.09135/21.23202ms versus reference22.58078/22.83719ms, but width10 reached0.6666629887 with active p50/p95 21.13692/21.67296ms. Thus width10 had no convincing latency advantage over active width12 and lost0.000274049 AUC relative to it; it still exceeds the original-entry tolerance and is not retrospectively declared a failure under a previously unknown rule. Timing across repeated identical controls varies (e.g. indexed width12 full inference28.36396s versus later30.15303s); cost repetition matters. None of the supplied trial receipts requests tensor diagnostics; identical AUC is weaker evidence than full prediction/gradient equivalence. Current code still computes/scorers 70 rows per example at evaluation, but readouts consume uniform and two feedback strata only. Pinned Dice uses BatchNorm1d with running statistics; DIN primary text explicitly distinguishes training batch moments from evaluation moving averages. Can removing evaluation-only support work lower measured prediction cost without altering the learned function, and can a one-unit residual reduction from12 to11 additionally preserve click quality? Prospective screening rule for this round, not an assertion about earlier preregistration: epsilon=0.0002 absolute click AUC. A candidate must have concurrent-reference delta >= -0.0002 AND AUC >= 0.666553547526167 (original joint entry 0.666753547526167 minus epsilon). Against the archived width12 AUC 0.666937037651279, the first threshold would be 0.666737037651279; the concurrent control remains binding. Auxiliary metrics and logloss must be reported but never replace click AUC for selection. Single-seed passage is provisional. For repeated claims use three paired seeds when authorized/budgeted and, if the host exposes user-cluster resampling, require the paired 95% interval lower endpoint above -epsilon. Without that interface report seed variation and leave population noninferiority unresolved.
study.hypothesis: The extra four support strata per block remain consequential for training Dice moments and attached gradients, yet have no cross-row effect once evaluation uses fixed running statistics. Omitting their compression/rotation/scoring/pooling only during eval should preserve the mathematical readouts and trained state and lower model-only prediction latency. Independently, width11 may retain more useful residual capacity than width10 at slightly fewer parameters than12. Width11 quality and runtime effects are unverified and may be nonmonotonic. This is an execution/capacity study of the inherited model, not a new unified representation or originality claim.
